notes: The supplied description names coping in relation to negative emotionality, but p. 995 (PDF p. 7), Table 2 reports separate Avoidant Coping, Active Coping and Seeking Support paths from positive and negative mood and four other predispositions. Neither a unique coping outcome nor equivalence between negative emotionality and negative mood is established by the supplied locator. No candidate is assigned to the row. Printed candidates from the negative mood row, not verified target effects: Avoidant Coping .30 (p < .001), Active Coping .16 (p < .01), Seeking Support .20 (p < .001). Metric: standardized structural-model path parameter estimates, not printed zero-order r; Table 2 note bases significance on the unstandardized estimate divided by its standard error. The p legend is OCR-corrupted in canonical text; rendered PDF p. 7 confirms * p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001. Model 1 has an explicit final analytic sample of 672 participants, not a recruitment total. However, row-to-test correspondence remains unresolved; this is a model-N candidate for parent field-scope review only. Two Time 2 incomplete/improper questionnaires were dropped; final respondents completed both waves and had registrar-verified identification. Missing scale/item data were imputed as described in Analysis, p. 992. No N was inferred from df or summed. No effect-size conversion performed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
